_note: The hole's milestones (F-005): one list, tracked per hole with the day each was reached, saved. check is population (at least `at` people), born (at least `at` children born), floors (at least `at` floors dug), harvest (at least `at` crops harvested, all told: a farm's first harvest, once its grow time has passed), grownUp (at least `at` children grown up here), generation (a child of generation `at` born: arrivals are the first, children of arrivals the second), passedAway (at least `at` elders passed away), fullRing (every slot of one floor's ring dug, not counting the rings the landing crew blasted out), domed, holesCapped (the network's: at least `at` holes capped, reached once for the whole network in the hole that got it there, #413), selfSufficient (#183: the hole has kept its people fed, watered, breathing and powered at its current size for `months` game months, with help from `tier`: earth (supply drops or trade), trade (rovers, net of what it sends, no drops) or alone; judged from what it makes against its people's needs, the shortfall Earth's drops top up, sim/sufficiency.ts, with `sufficiency` below), noDrops (no supply drop has landed for `at` months, with people still living here), founded (the hole has founded at least `at` others: its kit made it), and the network's tradeRoutes (at least `at` trade routes set up), holesLinked (at least `at` holes joined by trade routes, either way) and culturesApart (one hole's culture is at least `gap` from every other's, culture.ts cultureGap: 0 the same, 2 opposite on everything) or closedLoop (with at least `at` people, so the landing kit's recycler and a tiny crew don't close it by themselves, #441: over the last whole month, treatment put back into `loop` more than the loop lost for good: each room's water taken beyond what it returned, plus overflow; sim/milestones.ts); event milestones are reached only by an event's `celebrate` effect (data/events.json). celebrate: true also proposes a celebration (events.json `celebrations`), one at a time. title fills {title} in `reached` (the news) and {milestone} on the celebration card. hint says how to get there, in the milestones panel. group sorts them for the panel, in this order. Older saves mark what they've already passed as reached, day unknown, without news.

sufficiency._note: needs: the shortfalls Earth's drops top up (sim/earth.ts dailyGaps), each with the resources that meet it, which rovers may bring. tolerance: a shortfall up to this share of the need still counts as covered.
